$comment: INFRA-HIGH-227: the single source for every third-party image CI pulls at run time.
Anonymous pulls from Docker Hub (INFRA-HIGH-213) and from ECR Public (INFRA-HIGH-227) share a
per-source-IP quota with every tenant on the GitHub-hosted runner egress IPs, so CI failed
with toomanyrequests whatever the change. Each entry is copied once, by digest, into GHCR
under this repository by .github/workflows/ci-image-mirror.yml, and CI pulls the copy with
name:     repository under ghcr.io/okan-wqm/aquaculture_platform/ci/ (an entry is name + tag).
upstream: the Docker official image and tag the digest was resolved from (provenance only).
digest:   the upstream multi-arch index digest. The mirror keeps it byte-for-byte, so
upstream@digest and mirror@digest name the same content.
tag:      the upstream tag, also pushed on the mirror.
`credentials` and job `packages: read`) and testcontainers (apps/sensor-ingestion reads this
file at compile time). tests/invariants/ci-image-registry.spec.ts fails on any other form.
